proposals.summary: Add a stop-level transfer hold rule for buses at the university and stadium stations, and tighten the terminal queue-relief dispatch threshold to 4.5.
proposals.rationale: The champion has 285 missed connections and strong evidence of riders arriving at stops just after a bus leaves, especially at the rail stations where r1 and r3 meet the train. A new stop-level hold that waits for an imminent train when enough transferring riders are expected should convert those near-misses into connections without holding full or unneeded buses. Tightening queue-relief-dispatch from 3 to 4.5 reduces unnecessary early dispatch on short queues, which the probe shows is worth about -1.5%; combining both focused changes should clear the 1% promotion bar. Changes: Added new rule hold-for-transfer-onboard on bus_at_stop holding up to 45s when at a station, train is within 60s, and expected transfers >= 20; Tightened queue-relief-dispatch threshold from route_queue >= 3 to route_queue >= 4.5.
